name: NOAH & INNA
bio: Hello, I'm Nur Ain Hassan—just call me Ain. I create music-led videos, educational content and handcrafted 3D clay animation. My work lives on the Noah Inna YouTube channel, with each video credited 'Created by Electronic Tiger Creative Studio.' This space brings together the different ways I explore music, learning and visual creativity.
tagline: NOAH INNA · ELECTRONIC TIGER CREATIVE STUDIO
Handcrafted ideas, brought to the screen.

experiences.description: The creative studio name credited on Ain's YouTube videos: 'Created by Electronic Tiger Creative Studio.'
